The '''Senate Bureau of Intelligence''', or '''SBI''', was the primary civilian intelligence service for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was tasked with providing the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with domestic and foreign intelligence and to investigate possible security threats, both external and internal, to the Senate and its members.

==History==
The Senate Bureau of Intelligence was the largest of the Republic's intelligence agencies, and was at least partly responsible to the [[Senate Intelligence Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Intelligence Oversight Committee]]. The SBI was separate from its counterpart, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]], which was a [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] intelligence organization. The SBI was given expanded powers by the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], and by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Before the War, corruption did exist in the SBI. Low-level agents were known to aid corrupt senators in their schemes by passing on misinformation for the right price. [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was a member of the SBI, but the mass-corruption of the agency led him to resign in disgust. Just before the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Chancellor Palpatine empowered [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director-General]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] to reform the Bureau to increase security and reduce corruption. For the first time in over sixty years, Isard formed a [[Crisis Branch]] run by hand-picked a committee of Intelligence subdirectors from bureaus throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. The first act of this branch was the firing of thirty-two corrupt remote intelligence subdirectors throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. While some [[Senator/Legends|senators]] were concerned that this reformed SBI was just a front to increase the Chancellor's powerbase, Isard asserted that such measures would help eliminate systemic flaws in Intelligence's methods, preventing mishaps such as the notorious failure to predict the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo blockade]] and the [[Yinchorri Uprising|Yinchorri crisis]].<ref>{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_3.html|Isard Spearheads Republic Intelligence Reform}}</ref>     

During the early Clone Wars, the SBI worked to detect and uncover many secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] projects such as the development of [[Malevolence/Legends|superweapons]], creation of a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|battle droid equivalent]] of the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], and plans to create a [[Morgukai Shadow Army|clone army of their own]]. Many dangerous and high-profile targets were tracked such as [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] and the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]]. Dooku's elusiveness and omnipresence led many to believe that he had created a [[Doppelgänger of Dooku|clone of himself]]. The SBI also investigated rumors that the [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s were being resurrected as Separatist [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|strike force]] by the [[Spar|son]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Political opponents were also monitored by the SBI such as the [[Delegation of 2000]] and the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]].

[[Dyne]], [[Vyn Narcassan]], [[Travale]], and [[Inglemenn Barezz]] were all SBI agents during the Clone Wars. Agent [[Trachta]] served as a liason between the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and Director-General Armand Isard. [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], and [[Valiant (clone trooper)|Valiant]] all worked alongside the SBI during the war.

The last SBI Director-General was Armand Isard who also served as [[Director of Republic Intelligence]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], SBI became the core of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].

One department was the [[Cryptanalysis Department]] headed by [[Ilko Deminar]]. Another was the [[Crisis Branch]] established by Armand Isard.
